text: {"memo": "Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) delivered strong FY2024 results, with revenue reaching $350.02\u202fbillion, up from $307.39\u202fbillion in FY2023, representing roughly a 14% year\u2011over\u2011year increase. Net income rose to $100.12\u202fbillion in FY2024, well above the $73.80\u202fbillion recorded in FY2023, driving a net margin expansion to about 29% from 24% a year earlier. Operating income improved to $112.39\u202fbillion in FY2024 versus $84.29\u202fbillion in FY2023, lifting the operating margin to roughly 32% from 27%. Diluted EPS climbed to $8.04 in FY2024 from $5.80 in FY2023, and operating cash flow increased to $125.30\u202fbillion from $101.75\u202fbillion, underscoring robust cash generation. The combination of accelerating top\u2011and\u2011bottom\u2011line growth, widening margins, and strong cash conversion supports a positive outlook for the business. One\u2011line view: Alphabet remains a high\u2011quality growth platform with improving profitability and cash flow, justifying a premium valuation."}
